# EV Charging Cost Calculator (US & UK)
> Free interactive electric vehicle charging cost calculator comparing home charging, off-peak tariffs, and public DC rapid charging against gas (US $/Gallon) and petrol (UK £/Litre & p/kWh).

## Core Interactive Tool
- [EV Charging Cost Calculator (US & UK Modes)](https://www.evcalculator.online/): Calculate cost per mile, cost per full charge (0-100% & 10-80%), and monthly/annual savings vs gas or petrol with Level 2 charging loss factored in.
